officialLinks.label: Current GPA formula, transcript definitions and historical scales
Current plus/minus grade-point values and GPA example

helpIntro: Purdue uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter semester credit hours and final grades to estimate your current, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For current undergraduate Purdue coursework. Transfer grades do not enter the Purdue GPA, and older Purdue transcript work may use a historical scale. Repeat Impact estimates one same-course replacement using the most recent grade.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 quality points and a 4-credit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 25.2 ÷ 7 = 3.600.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.WF: Withdrawal notation; excluded from current GPA calculations.

specialTypes.name: Purdue course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter the Purdue course credit hours and final grade shown on the current-scale record.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: External transfer credit may apply to degree requirements, but the external grade does not enter the Purdue GPA.

specialTypes.name: Historical Purdue coursework (before current scale)
specialTypes.note: Purdue has used multiple historical grading scales. Use the transcript-era scale instead of the current calculator.

repeatPolicy.note: For a same-course, same-grade-mode repeat, Purdue uses the most recent grade in the cumulative GPA. This estimator models one replacement; verify third attempts or equivalent-course approvals with your advisor.
